Remote brand designer pay in 2026 is a $1,500–$5,000 fixed-price market — but only 22% of remote listings ever show the money.

We looked at 3,940 active remote listings on Loker Dollar. Just 853 (22%) disclose any pay figure. The two brand-design postings that do publish rates sit at $3,000–$5,000 (Stevens, fixed project) and $1,500–$3,000 (Sidekicks Creative Studio, fixed project).

The rest of the market is more opaque: 78% of listings omit pay, and 64% (2,507 roles) are open to worldwide applicants.

One takeaway for freelancers: a higher fixed price is not always better. A $3,000–$5,000 lump-sum sprint can mean short, high-pressure delivery windows, while a $1,500–$3,000 retainer may give steadier cash flow and room to upsell.

Full breakdown, methodology, and live listings: https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/remote-brand-designer-salary-trends-2026
